categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor equipment including front-end semiconductor process equipment such as cleaning devices, electroplating equipment, vertical furnace tube series, coating and developing track equipment, PECVD equipment, stress-free polishing equipment, back-end advanced packaging equipment, and silicon material substrate manufacturing process equipment. It also offers customized, high-performance, and low-consumption process solutions to semiconductor manufacturers to improve production efficiency and product yield while reducing costs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary SAPS and TEBO megasonic cleaning technologies for uniform and damage-free wafer cleaning, multi-anode localized electroplating technology for copper interconnects, stress-free polishing combining electrochemical polishing with CMP, and advanced packaging electroplating technologies. The company also develops vertical furnace tube equipment, coating and developing track systems, and PECVD equipment with independent intellectual property rights. Production methods emphasize modular design, precise process control, and integration of chemical and physical cleaning and plating techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor manufacturers primarily located in China mainland, Taiwan, South Korea, and the US, including major players like SK Hynix, SMIC, Yangtze Memory Technologies, Huahong Group, and Hefei Changxin. The company serves the integrated circuit manufacturing industry, covering logic chips, DRAM, 3D NAND, advanced packaging, and compound semiconductors, addressing markets in consumer electronics, AI, automotive electronics, IoT, and advanced computing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China mainland with significant market penetration, and has subsidiaries and R&D centers in Shanghai, Wuxi, Beijing, Chengdu, Hong Kong, South Korea, and California, USA. It actively expands its global footprint targeting semiconductor manufacturing hubs in China, Taiwan, South Korea, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a semiconductor equipment manufacturer supplying critical process tools to wafer fabs and packaging facilities. It also engages in upstream R&D and collaborates with suppliers for key components, maintaining a comprehensive supply chain management system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on technology differentiation, product platformization, and global customer expansion. R&D emphasizes innovation in megasonic cleaning, electroplating, stress-free polishing, advanced packaging, and dry process equipment like PECVD. The company invests heavily in developing equipment for advanced nodes (28nm and below), 3D NAND, DRAM, and compound semiconductors, aiming to achieve international advanced or leading technology levels. It also strengthens intellectual property protection and expands R&D teams in China and Korea.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related spare parts to semiconductor manufacturers. The company follows a build-to-order production model based on customer orders and forecasts, with no distribution or dealership channels. It also earns income from technology licensing and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the top five global players in semiconductor cleaning equipment with a 6.6% global market share and 23% share in China. It competes with international giants such as DNS, TEL, LAM, and SEMES, which dominate the global market. Domestically, it competes with companies like North Huachuang, Xinyuanwei, and Zhichun Technology. The company is recognized as one of China's top five semiconductor equipment manufacturers and is positioned as a leading domestic innovator with growing international competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 5.62 billion, a 44.48% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.15 billion, up 26.65%. Total assets grew 24.35% to RMB 12.13 billion, and net assets increased 18.69% to RMB 7.67 billion. The company maintains a strong cash flow position with operating cash inflows of RMB 1.22 billion. It has a robust R&D investment accounting for nearly 15% of revenue and a steadily increasing workforce, especially in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes differentiated technology and innovation, particularly its proprietary SAPS and TEBO megasonic cleaning technologies that ensure uniform energy distribution and damage-free cleaning at advanced technology nodes. Its multi-anode localized electroplating and stress-free polishing technologies offer superior process control and cost efficiency. The integration of modular design and environmental sustainability, such as reduced chemical consumption and solvent recovery, further differentiates its products. The company provides customized, high-performance, and low-consumption solutions that improve production yield and reduce costs, earning strong recognition from leading semiconductor manufacturers.
